# emulator (ADR 0008): tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb remove with the click b@x,y,T, which runs the evaluator 0x44b6e6 on the node and
# then the placement for the building type T (a decimal number), the object code taken from the size table 0x42d307 (2 small, 3 large). The
# lines are the emulator's output with the label, the clock, the storage item, and the generator words left out; see building-sites.txt for
# the form and the bytes of the building item b<slot>: from the byte 4 the type shifted left 2 with bit 7 (under construction), the status, the
# flag's slot plus one, the fill, the worker, the progress word (1 for a small site, 0 for a large one), the target height, and the planks and
# the stones the type needs (the table 0x449f18). Not production code: no routine of the program is transcribed here, only values the program
# produced.
